Marco (customer): hey team — our web client shows repeated SSE disconnects in prod since yesterday. users report partial responses (cut off mid-token) and then the client immediately reconnects and sometimes gets duplicate partial chunks.

Marco (customer): i grabbed a pcap during a repro — see a bunch of TCP RSTs to the backend around ~60s after connect. curl against the same endpoint shows stream stops with 200 then nothing.

Aisha (support): thanks Marco — can you paste the requestId/trace-id from the last broken stream and a minimal curl repro? also which region and product key?

Marco (customer): trace-id=rid_2f8c9b; region=us-west-2; apikey=redacted. curl repro is: 

  curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
    -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
    "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams?model=xlarge"

Marco (customer): also saw some 401s right before the reconnects in our client logs — we rotate tokens every 55s, but server still accepts the first few requests. not sure if that lines up.

Aisha (support): ok grabbing logs for rid_2f8c9b…

deploy-bot: deploy completed: inference-runtime v3.2.4 rolled to us-west-2 at 2026-03-12T14:12:33Z

Aisha (support): jamila — can you check LB and target group timeouts and any RST stats?

Jamila (sre): looking. from infra metrics: ALB idle_timeout currently 60s for that env. TCP_RST count to backend target spiked at the same window you reported. also seeing keepalive probes from client occasionally.

Jamila (sre): pcap snippet (filtered in wireshark):

  10:12:01.000 TCP 192.0.2.45:53214 -> 198.51.100.10:443 [PSH, ACK] 
  10:13:01.005 TCP 198.51.100.10:443 -> 192.0.2.45:53214 [RST] 

Jamila (sre): that looks like LB closing idle connections at ~60s. the stream server isn't sending keepalive comments.

Rohan (eng): interesting — two possible contributing factors: (1) ALB idle timeout 60s will drop pure-idle TLS connections; (2) our client token rotation -> temporary 401s could cause client to tear down connection and immediately reconnect which can look like a reconnect loop. need to confirm which comes first in the timeline.

Aisha (support): Marco — can you confirm whether the client logs show a 401 before the RSTs? you mentioned seeing 401s. which one happens first?

Marco (customer): checked ordered logs: 401 appears at 10:12:59.890, client triggers reconnect at 10:12:59.895, packet capture shows RST from server at 10:13:01.005 (so ~1.1s later). looks like client reconnect then LB teardown.

Rohan (eng): that sequence means client reconnect is initiated on 401, opens new connection while existing connection still open, LB later tears down the old connection producing RSTs — client library likely doesn't handle overlapping connections gracefully and the app sees duplicate partial events.

Rohan (eng): repro steps we used locally to simulate:

  1) start EventSource polyfill with token A, connect to SSE endpoint
  2) after 55s rotate token to B and respond with a 401 for the open connection (simulate auth server latency)
  3) client code immediately attempts reconnect with new token while old TCP conn remains open -> duplicates + partial messages when LB drops old TCP.

Rohan (eng): minimal Node repro snippet:

  const EventSource = require('eventsource');
  let token = 'A';
  const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams?model=xlarge', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  es.onmessage = (m) => console.log('MSG', m.data);
  setTimeout(() => { token = 'B'; /* rotate */ /* trigger 401 by rejecting token on server */ }, 55000);

Aisha (support): thanks. for immediate mitigation, jamila — can infra set ALB idle_timeout to 120s for that target group? and engineering: can we add keepalive comment frames from runtime every 30s as a short-term fix? both will stop LB RSTs cutting streams.

Jamila (sre): raising infra change now — filling change: increase idle_timeout to 120 for tx-targetgroup-43 in us-west-2. rollback window 30m.

billing-bot: note: increasing idle timeout may slightly increase LB cost; estimated +2% for that target group at current traffic.

Rohan (eng): longer-term fix: server should emit SSE comment lines (":\n") every 20–30s when no events to keep connection alive through ALBs. also update client SDK to: 
  - on 401 while stream is open, attempt token refresh but do exponential backoff before immediate reconnects; 
  - deduplicate events server-side when event-id header is present; 
  - make client tolerate duplicate chunks gracefully.

Marco (customer): sounds good. do you want our pcap? i can share a link.

Aisha (support): please upload the pcap to the support artifact bucket and paste link. also include the curl -v output you ran.

Marco (customer): uploaded: https://s3-us-west-2.example/support-artifacts/pcap_rid_2f8c9b.pcap

Jamila (sre): change executed: idle_timeout set to 120 at 2026-03-12T15:08:42Z — monitoring for new RST spikes.

Jamila (sre): quick check on new connections — no new RSTs in the last 10m on targetgroup-43.

Aisha (support): engineering note: we pushed a small runtime patch to emit keepalive comments every 25s in the streaming path to reduce LB idle tear-downs. patch id: STREAM-keepalive-2026-03-12.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: STREAM-keepalive-2026-03-12 to us-west-2 at 2026-03-12T15:12:05Z

Marco (customer): we verified on our side — reconnects stopped, no duplicates seen in a 30m smoke test. thanks!

Rohan (eng): follow-ups: (1) client SDK update to exponential backoff on reconnect after auth failures, (2) add event-id dedupe guidance in docs, (3) run a canary with ALB timeout change across other regions. I'll open tickets.

Aisha (support): closing the escalation as resolved pending Marco confirmation in 24h. please reopen if any regression. :thumbsup:

Marco (customer): will do, thanks all :heart:
